dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: That name... It's cute... but not cute-cute, y'know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What is this place?

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: It's my cafe! And let me tell you, this will become the resort's absolute best cafe in the near future. What do you think? Looks wonderful, doesn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Aside from the cafe's decor, name, equipment, and all that other nonsense, I've already got everything else covered! We're ready for anything!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Ready for anything... with nothing prepared?

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Don't you sweat the details, we'll build that bridge when we get to it! Just come back to me once business is booming, and I'll give you a discount.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Good luck building your bridges.

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Same to you!

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: That name... It's cute... but not cute-cute, y'know?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you still thinking of a name?

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: That's right! We worked so hard to get the decor right, but now it doesn't match the name I had in mind... What a headache!

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Gah! I didn't expect my dream coming true to come hand in hand with all these nuisances...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How's Zolin doing?

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Lil' Floaty's doing just great, and all thanks to you!

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Although he's lost his reputation as a well-known architect and still owes a lot of money as compensation for damages, he's finally back on the right track. He's less mentally burdened these days, too.

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: *sigh* That's life. What isn't meant to be yours will always remain beyond reach — plus, being a loyal assistant isn't so bad. If the old man were here, I'm sure he'd give his approval.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Cozatl...

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: We still haven't heard from him...

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Honestly, even though Lil' Floaty and I don't hold it against him, I don't know if he'll be able to forgive himself... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: But that's that, I suppose. Cozatl's a smart guy — he can handle himself out there. And once he's learned to forgive himself, I'm sure we'll meet again.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm sure you will.

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: That's the spirit!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: That's all from me. Sorry for disturbing you.

dialogues.speaker: Tochtli
dialogues.text: Don't you worry, feel free to come back and chat whenever!
